description: This Java class 'SslUtil' provides utility methods for handling SSL certificates and private keys, including reading certificates from files or strings, reading private keys with optional passwords, and managing cryptographic providers.

classes.name: SslUtil
classes.description: Utility class for SSL certificate and private key processing, including reading certificates and private keys from strings or files, with support for encrypted keys and provider management.

methods.name: readCertFile
methods.description: Reads X509 certificates from a string content.

methods.name: readCertFileByPath
methods.description: Reads X509 certificates from a file path.

methods.name: readPrivateKey
methods.description: Reads a private key from a string content with optional password.

methods.name: readPrivateKeyByFilePath
methods.description: Reads a private key from a file path with optional password.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Converts a password string to a character array, or returns an empty array if null or empty.
